title: The Fizz Drink Title Fight
description: The Fizz Drink Title Fight — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Negotiate with Vergrim in his lair off of Level 7 of Vergrim's Vexation for his Fizz Drink Recipe and Return to Audrey in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 10 King's Coins

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Zone: Vergrim's Vexation (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Negotiate with Vergrim in his lair off of Level 7 of Vergrim's Vexation for his Fizz Drink Recipe and Return to Audrey in Townston.

Offer:

Well, I gave it the ol' Alechemical Juniour College try, but I can't seem to crack the recipe for Vergrim's Fizzerator drink. I have already started the wheels in motion on some in-dungeon advertising for my new line of potions so I need that recipe! Will you go and ask Vergrim for it? Try some strong arm tactics, like using your strong arms to destroy Vergrim, then you can just take the recipe and bring it back to me.

Once you have killed Vergrim I need you to bring me back the recipe for Vergrim's Fizzerator. There has been a lot of push back on the in-dungeon advertising, so if I do convince the King's Board of Trustees to go ahead with it, I better have a product to sell!

Turn-in:

You got the recipe! Fantastic! Let me see it, please. Oh, I didn't even think about that ingredient. Ewww! It has that in it? Well, that is going to be a hard ingredient to find... I mean, where am I going to find an albino mountain platypus?! I suppose that isn't your problem, so I won't keep you any longer. Thank you for your help, Dungeon Runner, and here is your reward.

Objectives:

  • Negotiate with Vergrim
  • Vergrim's Fizzerator Recipe ×1

Client level range: 20–30
